name: repository-confinement
description: Keep an agent's writes inside the worktree it was started in.

WRITE_SCOPE.says: where a write may land: the worktree the session started in, or any worktree of the same repository

SCRATCHPAD_PATHS.says: the client's own temporary directories, read and written freely, separated by colons

STATE_PATHS.says: directories outside the repository an agent keeps state in, read and written freely, separated by colons

CONFIG_PATHS.says: agent configuration directories, read without asking and never written, separated by colons

PASTED_IMAGE_PATHS.says: where an image pasted into chat lands, so reading one there does not ask, separated by colons
